method: Five paired run ratios, geometric means and 95% Student t intervals on log ratios (df=4); no multiple-comparison adjustment.
limits: Cross-condition GPU UUIDs can differ within the verified H100 pool.
Dynamo worker policy varied; frontend stayed allowed with a one-CPU limit.
CPU/request is a cgroup estimate excluding ingress and mesh sidecars.
These are warmed steady-state measurements, not cold loading or disk-heavy I/O.
Restore also changes process and seccomp state; its effects are not isolated io_uring effects.
